notes:
MiniQoL is standalone, so MegaLoad now keeps it on a profile of its own. Installing MiniQoL deletes the other Mega mods from that profile, and installing a Mega mod into a MiniQoL profile removes MiniQoL. You get a confirm box first listing exactly what goes. Your configs are kept, so switching back restores your settings. Thunderstore mods are never touched.

On Create Profile, ticking MiniQoL clears the other starter mods and ticking a Mega mod clears MiniQoL. Updates never delete anything.
